title: Thundercats #2
desc: THE FERAL KING IS ON THE LOOSE! The ThunderCats give chase, desperate to stop the uncontrollable Lion-O from harming innocents on Third Earth, or himself! And what is the awful truth behind his SAVAGE transformation!? From superstar GREG PAK (World War Hulk) and artist DAVID COUSENS (Cheetara: Worldbreaker)!
